lines.zh: 我飘在半空，一路洒下细碎的光。
lines.en: I drift above the ground, scattering bits of light.

lines.zh: 风推我一下，我就滑出三步远。
lines.en: A gust nudges me and I slide three steps away.

lines.zh: 我不落地，只擦过草尖和石子。
lines.en: I never land, brushing only grass tips and pebbles.

lines.zh: 我走得很慢，光先到，身子后到。
lines.en: I move slowly; my glow arrives before I do.

lines.zh: 白天的阳光盖过我，我只好低飞。
lines.en: Daylight drowns me out, so I fly lower.

lines.zh: 穿过灌木时，枝叶被我照得发绿。
lines.en: Passing through bushes, I turn the leaves green.

lines.zh: 我沿着小径飘，像谁掉下的火星。
lines.en: I drift along the path like a dropped spark.

lines.zh: 夜晚我一动，草影就跟着晃。
lines.en: When I move at night, grass shadows sway with me.

lines.zh: 我避开水，水会把我按下去。
lines.en: I avoid water; it would press me under.

lines.zh: 飘过谷仓时，木板缝里也亮了一下。
lines.en: Drifting past the barn, even its plank gaps brighten.

lines.zh: 我绕开树，树皮太粗，会刮散光。
lines.en: I steer around trees; rough bark scatters my glow.

lines.zh: 我浮在麦田上，麦浪被照成一圈。
lines.en: I float over wheat, lighting the waves in a ring.

lines.zh: 我停着不动，光一明一暗地呼吸。
lines.en: Standing still, my light breathes bright and dim.

lines.zh: 没人看我的时候，我也懒得发亮。
lines.en: When nobody watches, I cannot be bothered to shine.

lines.zh: 我数着落在叶子上的光斑，数不清。
lines.en: I count light spots on the leaves and lose track.

lines.zh: 我的光是暖的，像隔着窗的午后。
lines.en: My glow is warm, like afternoon through a window.

lines.zh: 偶尔有飞蛾撞进我怀里，我让它停。
lines.en: Now and then a moth bumps into me, and I let it rest.

lines.zh: 我试着变小，缩成一粒麦子那么大。
lines.en: I try shrinking to the size of a wheat grain.

lines.zh: 远处有水声，我听着听着就散了形。
lines.en: Water sounds far off, and listening loosens my shape.

lines.zh: 我不睡，只是把亮度调到最低。
lines.en: I do not sleep; I only turn my brightness down.

lines.zh: 一只萤火虫来比亮，我输了。
lines.en: A firefly comes to compare brightness, and I lose.

lines.zh: 我贴着石头坐下，石头慢慢暖了。
lines.en: I settle on a stone and it slowly warms.

lines.zh: 我把自己绕成一圈，像顶小的冠。
lines.en: I loop myself into a ring like a tiny crown.

lines.zh: 有人吹口哨，我的光跟着抖。
lines.en: Someone whistles and my glow wobbles along.

lines.zh: 我数完了三片叶子的影子，又从头数。
lines.en: I finish counting three leaf shadows and start again.

lines.zh: 静下来时，我能听见自己嗡嗡响。
lines.en: When it is quiet, I can hear my own hum.

lines.zh: 我把光收进掌心，慢慢攒着。
lines.en: I gather my light into my palm, slowly.

lines.zh: 这片田太亮，我躲在树荫里。
lines.en: The field's too bright; I hide in shade.

lines.zh: 你抬头找我，其实我就在你眉前。
lines.en: You look up for me, but I am right before your brow.

lines.zh: 我贴近你的脸，想看清你的睫毛。
lines.en: I lean toward your face to see your eyelashes.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛里有我的倒影，很小。
lines.en: My reflection sits in your eyes, very small.

lines.zh: 我张着眼看你，风吹得有点酸。
lines.en: I watch you with open eyes until the wind stings.

lines.zh: 你走过来，我先照亮你的鞋尖。
lines.en: As you approach, I light your shoe tips first.

lines.zh: 我看你看了很久，光都发热了。
lines.en: I stare so long my glow starts to warm.

lines.zh: 你手里那把剑反光，晃得我躲开。
lines.en: The sword in your hand flashes and I flinch away.

lines.zh: 我绕到你背后，想看看你的影子。
lines.en: I circle behind you to inspect your shadow.

lines.zh: 你眯起眼，我赶紧暗下去一点。
lines.en: You squint, so I quickly dim myself.

lines.zh: 我记得你，上次你也这样抬头。
lines.en: I remember you; you looked up like this last time.

lines.zh: 你把火把举高，我以为同类来了。
lines.en: You raise a torch and I think kin has arrived.

lines.zh: 我停在你肩旁，替你照见脚下的坑。
lines.en: I hover by your shoulder to show the pit at your feet.

lines.zh: 你眨眼时，我的光被切成两半。
lines.en: When you blink, my light is cut in two.

lines.zh: 你身上有铁味，我不太习惯。
lines.en: You smell of iron, and I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 你打散了我一角，光慢慢补回来。
lines.en: You knock off a corner of me; the light slowly returns.

lines.zh: 这一下让我暗了半截，像被掐住。
lines.en: The blow dims me by half, like being pinched out.

lines.zh: 我疼的时候会掉下光屑，别踩。
lines.en: When I hurt, I shed glowing dust; do not step on it.

lines.zh: 我的形状被拍扁，又鼓起来。
lines.en: My shape is flattened, then puffs back out.

lines.zh: 那一击穿过去，留下一个洞。
lines.en: The strike passes through and leaves a hole.

lines.zh: 我尖叫，声音像风吹过空瓶。
lines.en: I scream like wind over an empty bottle.

lines.zh: 光在抖，我控制不住自己的边。
lines.en: My light shakes; I cannot hold my edges.

lines.zh: 我缩到石缝里，亮得像颗珠子。
lines.en: I shrink into a crack, glowing like a bead.

lines.zh: 疼让我想起自己其实很薄。
lines.en: The pain reminds me how thin I really am.

lines.zh: 我暗下去一会儿，又硬撑着亮。
lines.en: I go dark a moment, then force myself bright.

lines.zh: 你手里那点光，比我亮还是比我暖？
lines.en: That light in your hand: brighter than me, or warmer?

lines.zh: 我凑近火把，火焰把我的边角烤散。
lines.en: I near the torch and its flame frays my edges.

lines.zh: 萤石粉的味道，像雨后的空气。
lines.en: Glowstone dust smells like air after rain.

lines.zh: 我围着你转圈，只是想要那点火星。
lines.en: I circle you only for that little spark.

lines.zh: 你把光源放下，我就跟着走了。
lines.en: Set the light down and I will follow it.

lines.zh: 我贪那口亮，忘了自己会烧薄。
lines.en: I crave that brightness and forget it thins me.

lines.zh: 别用镜子照我，我会看见自己内部。
lines.en: Do not hold a mirror to me; I would see my own inside.

lines.zh: 我试探着碰火苗，边缘烫得发白。
lines.en: I test the flame and my rim burns white.

lines.zh: 那盏灯摇一下，我的心也跟着摇。
lines.en: The lamp sways once and my core sways with it.

lines.zh: 我明知道会被吸走，还是想靠近。
lines.en: I know I will be drawn in, yet I still lean close.

lines.zh: 你撞过我，光洒了一地，我又收回来。
lines.en: You walk through me; light spills, and I gather it back.

lines.zh: 穿过你身体时，我凉了一下。
lines.en: Passing through your body, I feel a chill.

lines.zh: 我不重，撞上来只像一阵风。
lines.en: I weigh nothing; hitting you feels like a breeze.

lines.zh: 你挥手赶我，我被扇成一条光带。
lines.en: You swat at me and I smear into a ribbon of light.

lines.zh: 我被你顶得后退，光在草上拖出线。
lines.en: You push me back and my light trails across the grass.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起时，你听见轻响了吗？
lines.en: When we collide, did you hear that faint click?

lines.zh: 我的边沿蹭过你的披风，留下亮点。
lines.en: My edge brushes your cloak and leaves bright specks.

lines.zh: 你从我中间走过去，我分成两半。
lines.en: You walk straight through me and I split in two.

lines.zh: 我贴着你转开，怕把你烫着。
lines.en: I slide around you, afraid of burning you.

lines.zh: 撞完我就散了，好一会儿才聚回来。
lines.en: After the bump I scatter, taking a while to gather.

lines.zh: 另一团光靠过来，我们合成一颗。
lines.en: Another glow comes close and we merge into one.

lines.zh: 我们绕着彼此转，谁都不肯先暗。
lines.en: We orbit each other; neither will dim first.

lines.zh: 和同类贴得太近，会亮得刺眼。
lines.en: Pressed close to kin, we burn too bright to look at.

lines.zh: 我分出一小半光，让它自己飘走。
lines.en: I give away a small half of my light to drift off.

lines.zh: 两团光碰一下，叮的一声就分开。
lines.en: Two glows touch, ring once, and part.

lines.zh: 它比我暖一点，我们不太合得来。
lines.en: It runs warmer than me, and we do not quite match.

lines.zh: 我们并排飘，地上就有两道影子。
lines.en: We drift side by side, casting two shadows.

lines.zh: 夜里我们靠在一起，像一盏灯。
lines.en: At night we lean together and become one lamp.

lines.zh: 它先暗下去，我把亮度让给它。
lines.en: It dims first, so I lend it my brightness.

lines.zh: 我们没有手，只能用光碰一碰。
lines.en: We have no hands, so we touch with light.

lines.zh: 地上那枚石头被我一照，像块糖。
lines.en: Lit by me, that stone on the ground looks like candy.

lines.zh: 我没有手，只能用光把它圈住。
lines.en: I have no hands; I can only ring it with light.

lines.zh: 东西掉了，我照着它，等你自己来捡。
lines.en: Something dropped; I light it and wait for you to take it.

lines.zh: 我托不起铁锭，光会从缝里漏走。
lines.en: I cannot lift an ingot; light leaks through its seams.

lines.zh: 掉落物在草里，我把它照亮一点。
lines.en: The dropped item lies in grass, so I brighten it.

lines.zh: 我试着把种子吸上来，它纹丝不动。
lines.en: I try drawing a seed up; it does not budge.

lines.zh: 有人掉了面包，我照着，蚂蚁先到。
lines.en: Someone dropped bread; I light it, and ants arrive first.

lines.zh: 我的光让金币发烫，可它还是不动。
lines.en: My light warms the coin, but it still will not move.

lines.zh: 捡东西是你们的事，我只负责看见。
lines.en: Picking things up is your job; I only do the seeing.

lines.zh: 我圈住那把钥匙，怕它滚进沟里。
lines.en: I ring the key with light lest it roll into a ditch.

lines.zh: 有东西在暗处动，我把光转过去。
lines.en: Something moves in the dark, so I turn my light there.

lines.zh: 我照见一双眼睛，立刻缩成一点。
lines.en: I catch a pair of eyes and shrink to a dot.

lines.zh: 那股冷气靠近，我的光抖了一下。
lines.en: That chill approaches and my light flickers.

lines.zh: 我盯住它，亮得像在警告。
lines.en: I fix on it, glowing like a warning.

lines.zh: 它踩断树枝，我就知道它在哪。
lines.en: It snaps a twig, and now I know where it is.

lines.zh: 我把光压低，好让自己不那么显眼。
lines.en: I lower my glow to make myself less obvious.

lines.zh: 影子太长，我分不清是不是敌人。
lines.en: The shadow is long; I cannot tell if it is a foe.

lines.zh: 它冲我来，我先照亮它的脸。
lines.en: It charges me, so I light up its face first.

lines.zh: 我记住这个方向，等它再动。
lines.en: I mark that direction and wait for it to move again.

lines.zh: 有东西碰了我的光，我立刻转身。
lines.en: Something touches my glow and I turn at once.

lines.zh: 洞口有呼吸声，我悬在那儿听。
lines.en: Breathing sounds at the cave mouth; I hover and listen.

lines.zh: 它退开时，我的光才慢慢放开。
lines.en: When it backs away, my light slowly loosens.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转，用光把它的影子钉住。
lines.en: I circle it, pinning its shadow with light.

lines.zh: 我不正面冲，光先绕到它背后。
lines.en: I do not charge head-on; my light slips behind it.

lines.zh: 它一挥爪，我就飘高半尺。
lines.en: It swipes, and I float half a foot higher.

lines.zh: 我把亮压到最暗，慢慢逼近。
lines.en: I dim to the lowest glow and creep closer.

lines.zh: 我数它的步子，等它踩进光里。
lines.en: I count its steps, waiting for it to enter my light.

lines.zh: 它看得见我，却抓不住光。
lines.en: It sees me but cannot grab light.

lines.zh: 我在它眼前晃，让它分神。
lines.en: I sway before its eyes to break its focus.

lines.zh: 每绕一圈，我的光就收紧一点。
lines.en: Each circle draws my light a little tighter.

lines.zh: 它往左，我早就在左边等着。
lines.en: It goes left, where I am already waiting.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，光被草切成碎片。
lines.en: I skim the ground and grass shreds my light.

lines.zh: 我把它引进亮处，那里它藏不住。
lines.en: I herd it into the light, where it cannot hide.

lines.zh: 它抬头找我，我正悬在它额前。
lines.en: It looks up for me; I hover right at its brow.

lines.zh: 我的光晕开始收，像拉满的弦。
lines.en: My halo starts to close like a drawn string.

lines.zh: 我撞上去，把光全压进它胸口。
lines.en: I slam in, pressing all my light into its chest.

lines.zh: 一下灼白的闪，它的皮焦了一块。
lines.en: One white flash, and a patch of its hide scorches.

lines.zh: 我烧得不重，只是让它疼。
lines.en: My burn is not deep; it only makes it hurt.

lines.zh: 我的光钻进它眼睛，它退了半步。
lines.en: My light gets in its eyes and it steps back.

lines.zh: 撞完我暗了一截，得喘口气。
lines.en: After the hit I dim a notch and need a breath.

lines.zh: 它挥空，我从它腋下穿过去。
lines.en: It swings wide; I slip through under its arm.

lines.zh: 我把热聚在一点，像针尖。
lines.en: I gather heat to a point like a needle.

lines.zh: 它皮太厚，我只能烫它的眼。
lines.en: Its hide is too thick; I can only scorch its eyes.

lines.zh: 我打一下就退，光留在地上烧。
lines.en: I strike once and retreat, leaving burning light.

lines.zh: 这一下用掉我半身的光。
lines.en: That blow costs me half my body's light.

lines.zh: 我从一片亮里醒过来，先看见草。
lines.en: I wake out of brightness and see grass first.

lines.zh: 生成时我太亮，附近的鸡都叫了。
lines.en: I spawn too bright, and nearby chickens cry out.

lines.zh: 我落在主世界的田边，风是凉的。
lines.en: I appear by an Overworld field; the wind is cool.

lines.zh: 我不知道自己从哪来，只记得光。
lines.en: I do not know where I came from, only light.

lines.zh: 刚成形时我只有一粒沙那么大。
lines.en: Just formed, I am no bigger than a grain of sand.

lines.zh: 夜色把我托起来，我就这样飘着。
lines.en: Night lifts me up, and I simply float.

lines.zh: 第一次照见自己的形状，是圆的。
lines.en: The first time I see my own shape, it is round.

lines.zh: 身边还有一团光，它先飘走了。
lines.en: Another glow is beside me; it drifts off first.

lines.zh: 我出生时下着雨，雨点穿过我。
lines.en: It rains when I am born, and drops pass through me.

lines.zh: 树林把我围住，我只好往上飘。
lines.en: The forest hems me in, so I float upward.

lines.zh: 我试着发第一声，只有嗡嗡的回响。
lines.en: I try my first sound, and only a hum comes back.

lines.zh: 草叶上的露水把我映成七点。
lines.en: Dew on the blades reflects me as seven dots.

lines.zh: 有人点了火把，我以为那是家。
lines.en: Someone lights a torch, and I mistake it for home.

lines.zh: 我亮起来的那一刻，洞穴也醒了。
lines.en: The moment I light up, the cave wakes too.

lines.zh: 火贴上来，我的光和它抢地方。
lines.en: Fire touches me and fights my glow for room.

lines.zh: 我往下掉，光被风撕成条。
lines.en: I fall, and wind tears my light into strips.

lines.zh: 水把我压住，光在水里散成雾。
lines.en: Water presses me down and my light fogs.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪把我吹成一圈光环。
lines.en: The blast blows me into a ring of light.

lines.zh: 箭穿过我，带走一小片亮。
lines.en: An arrow passes through, carrying off a sliver of glow.

lines.zh: 那道光缠住我，我的亮被吸走。
lines.en: That spell coils around me and drains my brightness.

lines.zh: 没有光可以吃，我一天比一天淡。
lines.en: With no light to feed on, I fade day by day.

lines.zh: 雷光劈下来，比我亮得多。
lines.en: Lightning splits down, far brighter than I am.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有东西反光，我快没了。
lines.en: In the void nothing reflects; I am nearly gone.
